pixel_format: RGBA8 straight alpha PNG, sRGB, transparent background (whole output, no crop)
renderer: original quickshell (QSG_RENDER_LOOP=basic, live env) on nested Hyprland (wayland backend on headless KWin), grim screencopy; alpha from a black/white compositor-background matte; virtual clock via LD_PRELOAD vclock
tolerance: compare premultiplied RGBA; exact, except images with distance_field_text: per-channel <= 2

composition.layer_order: entry.layers: Hyprland levels background<bottom<top<overlay, list order within a level = Hyprland render order
composition.clients: one fully transparent xdg toplevel provides activeToplevel's title

unreachable.reason: the battery trigger is interactive only while batteryInfo.available, and battery-info.sh is polled only while the popup is open (shell.qml:3342, 4078-4080); component references bar/battery-* are harness-seeded

matte.uncertain_meaning: physical px [x, y] where the black/white matte channels disagree (alpha may be off by up to half the spread)
